newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - December 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - December 31.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's edition of Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - New Line's Michael winged to the top of the charts with $17.4 million on the final weekend of 1996.
HOLLYWOOD - The national box office finished the weekend with a cumulative gross of slightly more than $5.7 billion for 1996.
SYDNEY - William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet looks set to be another star performer overseas for News Corp's Fox if its foreign preems over the weekend are anything to go by.
NEW YORK - Discovery's new Animal Planet cable network has alienated some cable operators and may have overplayed its hand in buying out the satellite slot occupied by WWOR.

HOLLYWOOD - As studio marketers finalize promotional tie-in plans for their summer blockbuster hopefuls, they have only to look at last week's lawsuit filed against the producers of Jerry Maguire to remind themselves of the fragile relationship between corporate America and Hollywood.
HOLLYWOOD - Los Angeles-based Pacific Theatres announced the groundbreaking of its $25-million, 25-screen megaplex in the San Fernando Valley.
